selection: User selected the vLLM-Ascend native AscendC reference identified in the handoff document.
handoff_document: 交接文档.md, section 910b4; official PR https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/17998

contract.A_log: FP32 [H]; prepare the no-copy flattening of [1,1,H,1] before capture
contract.cu_seqlens: host integer tuple or None; prepare from captured lengths before timing, never call device tolist inside capture
contract.semantics: bounded sigmoid gate -> inclusive token prefix sum reset per sequence/chunk -> 1/ln(2) scaling
contract.supported_raw_gate_scope: The inspected public adapter requires safe_gate=True, lower_bound in [-5,0), D<=256, and chunk size 32/64/128; variable-length rank4 requires B=1.

active_set: All 38 existing captured_shapes.json contracts, BF16 input, FP32 output, safe gate, chunk64, H=32,D=128; no substitution of the previous standalone softplus workload.
measurement_policy: Five paired rounds of 256-call native NPU Graph replay on the same NPU/container. Compile, autotune and host metadata preparation are outside capture. Both outputs are checked against independent math before capture and after replay. Full results are recorded separately in validation.
limitations: Binary provenance includes the pinned clean source, API/binding hashes and installed device-kernel artifact hashes in the validation report.

Ascend has a separate backend operator file. Full-package import in the current compiler environment is blocked by unrelated chunk_kda TLE dsa import incompatibility; isolated operator validation is labelled explicitly.
The native raw-gate reference requires safe_gate=True. Softplus production functionality is tested independently, not benchmarked against an unsupported native API mode.
AscendC scales each gate row before serial summation; the candidate preserves vLLM scaling after the scan. Floating-point order differs and both are checked with documented tolerances.
The previous standalone fused_kda_gate safe_gate=False baseline and separate FLA-NPU npu_kda_gate_cumsum are not used.

Native performance comparison uses finite synthetic values at all captured dimensions. Nonfinite production compatibility is tested against original vLLM triangular-dot behavior, not asserted equivalent to the vendor serial scan.

installed_reference.scope: Only the selected native operator and its minimal registration binding; not the full vLLM-Ascend Python package.
installed_reference.registration: Original upstream schema and host adapter; no replacement computation.
installed_reference.initial_preflight_note: initial_runtime_preflight describes the initial default interpreter, not this installed test environment.

initial_runtime_preflight.status: selected reference identified, not runtime-ready in the probed environment
initial_runtime_preflight.action_required_before_measurement: Provide/build the pinned vLLM-Ascend native extension in the personal container and verify binary/source provenance. Do not substitute another kernel when this operator is absent.
